cues: Your textbook calls this a modern tragedy.
Compare it with the classical kind.
The hero is not a king but an innkeeper.
He is destroyed not by fate or the gods but by debt and his family.
The language is everyday speech; the setting is a dining room; and the ending is a private death, after which life goes on.
